decisions_and_interpretations.text: Primary D1 day set = build_d1.py default `keep` (a run of 1-4 no-update minutes is a valid flat bar; runs >= 5 or starting 09:30 are missing). The strict reading (`keep_strict`: any no-update minute in 15:19-15:59 counts as missing) is reported for H1/H2 as a labelled sensitivity. Chosen because a flat Dukascopy record is a real price observation and the strict rule mostly drops quiet days, biasing toward active closes. Decided before any H1/H2 number was computed.
decisions_and_interpretations.source: this analysis (judgement on wording the pre-registration does not settle)

decisions_and_interpretations.text: S2 'best full-sample D1 t-stat' = the H2 predictor with the largest |Newey-West t| on the full D1 sample; trade direction = sign(t) x sign(P) (a reversal signal buys the opposite side). Made before D2 results were computed.

If P3 were the selected predictor its value is only known at the 15:51 open, so S2 would enter at the 15:51 bar open (strike nearest SPX then) instead of t0; otherwise S2 enters at t0. Forced by the no-look-ahead rule.

11-minute window starting at bar s = open of bar s to close of bar s+10 (same length as r_close: 15:49:00-16:00:00). The 15:38 window is open 15:38 -> close 15:48. Same-day median uses every available window starting 10:00..15:38 (339 when no bar is missing).
Strike nearest SPX = nearest point on the 5-point grid, ties rounded up; the contract must have a real (non-interpolated) 1-minute bar at entry or the day is not usable.

Fees are charged per executed trade: entry always; exit only when a leg is sold before expiry (cash settlement is not a trade). Half-spread is added to the entry mark and subtracted from a sale price; settlement value is intrinsic at the SPX official close.

S3 / exploratory (i): a leg is sold at multiple x entry mark minus half-spread (floored at 0) if the close of any real bar beginning 15:49..15:58 is >= multiple x entry mark (the 15:49 bar's close at 15:49:59 is later than the 15:49:00 entry).
decisions_and_interpretations.source: this analysis (reading of 'any later bar's close ... before 15:59')

decisions_and_interpretations.text: Realized vol to t0 = sqrt(sum of squared 1-minute log changes of bar opens 09:30..15:49, rescaled for missing pairs), from D1 on the D2 date. Model fitted on D1 2023-01-01..2026-10-20: |P_end/P_t0 - 1| = a + b*rv (OLS). Predicted move (points) = prediction x SPX at t0; compared with the D2 15:49 ATM straddle mark (C+P open). Pass-rule statistic = mean over usable D2 days of (predicted - implied); 95% CI from a day bootstrap that resamples D1 days (refitting) and D2 days. The ratio model (sum|r|/sum rv) and the unconditional mean are reported as descriptive alternatives.
decisions_and_interpretations.source: this analysis (pre-registration says 'ratio and regression'; workflow asked for the regression)

decisions_and_interpretations.text: Day-block bootstrap = resample whole days with replacement (block = 1 trading day), 10000 replications, percentile 95% CI, seed 20261021.
Newey-West: Bartlett weights, lag 5, p-value from the normal distribution; days where the predictor or target is undefined are dropped from that predictor's series.
